project.title: Launch of Cross-Sell Sales Playbook for Q3
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized cross-sell playbook to increase average deal size across key customer segments.
deliverables: Segmented cross-sell opportunity matrix by product and customer type
Standardized sales playbook with messaging, steps, and qualification criteria
Sales pipeline tracking dashboard for cross-sell deals
Training plan and rollout schedule for sales teams
Post-launch performance review report with improvement actions
constraints: Playbook must be ready before start of Q3 sales cycle
No changes to core pricing model during this project
Must align with existing CRM fields and workflows
Limited availability of frontline sales reps for workshops
Compliance with internal approval and discount policies

risks.risk: Low adoption of the new playbook by sales reps.
risks.mitigation: Involve sales managers in design, run pilot, and collect quick feedback for iteration.

risks.risk: Playbook misaligned with current CRM process, causing extra admin work.
risks.mitigation: Validate flows with CRM admin early and adjust templates to fit existing fields.

risks.risk: Overly complex playbook slows down sales cycles.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize simplicity, limit steps, and test with a small group of reps before full rollout.

risks.risk: Targets set in the dashboard are unrealistic and demotivate teams.
risks.mitigation: Co-create targets with sales managers and validate against historical performance data.

themes.why_relevant: Core goal is to harmonize how cross-sell is identified, pitched, and tracked across teams.
Playbook must reflect different needs and potential across customer segments.
Dashboard and KPIs are needed to prove impact and adjust tactics quickly.
Sales teams need clear communication, training, and quick wins to adopt the new playbook.
Cross-sell offers must respect margin, discount, and approval rules.

backlog.task: Define target customer segments and prioritize cross-sell opportunities for each
definition_of_done: List of segments agreed with stakeholders
Top 3 cross-sell opportunities defined per segment

backlog.task: Draft first version of the cross-sell sales playbook
definition_of_done: Document shared for review with sales managers

backlog.task: Align playbook with existing CRM fields and workflows
definition_of_done: Key CRM fields mapped to each playbook step
No new mandatory fields required without approval
Summary of CRM alignment validated with CRM admin

backlog.task: Create cross-sell opportunity matrix by product and segment
definition_of_done: Matrix lists primary and secondary products per segment
Estimated uplift potential added for each pairing
Matrix approved by at least two sales managers

backlog.task: Design KPI set and dashboard layout for cross-sell tracking
definition_of_done: Finance and sales managers sign off on KPI definitions

backlog.task: Plan and schedule pilot rollout with a small sales team
definition_of_done: Kickoff session scheduled and invites sent

backlog.task: Collect feedback from pilot sales reps and refine playbook
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least 5 pilot reps collected
Updated playbook version shared with project team

backlog.task: Define training approach and materials for full rollout
definition_of_done: Training plan aligned with sales managers

backlog.task: Set cross-sell targets by segment in coordination with finance
Document governance for discounts and approvals in cross-sell deals
Prepare Q3 launch communication for sales teams
definition_of_done: Key messages and benefits of playbook drafted

backlog.task: Compile post-launch performance and lessons learned report
definition_of_done: First 4 weeks of cross-sell data collected

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on target segments and top cross-sell opportunities for Q3.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking for agreement on segmentation and opportunity focus.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final list of target customer segments for the playbook.
Select top 3 cross-sell opportunities per segment to include in A1.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalize the first version of the cross-sell playbook.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager shares A2 draft and requests structured feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the final structure and key steps of the sales playbook.
Confirm that the playbook aligns with existing CRM workflows.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define pilot scope, participants, and success criteria.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager proposes a pilot plan and asks for volunteers and sign-off.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which sales team participates in the pilot and for how long.
Agree on pilot success metrics and feedback collection approach.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock training approach, rollout checklist, and launch communication.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager posts draft training plan and asks for final comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the training format and rollout timeline for all sales teams.
Sign off on the launch communication pack content and owners.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early Q3 results and agree on improvement actions.
threads_plan.trigger: Project manager shares initial performance data and A8 draft.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which improvement actions to prioritize for the next iteration.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning with yesterday/today/risks updates.
Twice-weekly quick review of pilot feedback and playbook tweaks.
Weekly KPI snapshot post with cross-sell performance vs targets.
Pre-launch go/no-go checklist review two days before Q3 start.
Post-launch retrospective thread at the end of the first month.
